# 温州市嘉伦织带有限公司 / Wenzhou Jialun Webbing Co., Ltd.

> Manufacturer of polyester and latex elastic webbing for footwear and pet-product applications, based in Tangxia Town, Rui'an, Zhejiang, China.

## Primary pages

- Chinese home: https://jialun.net/
- English home: https://jialun.net/en/
- Chinese product guide: https://jialun.net/products/
- English product guide: https://jialun.net/en/products/

## Verified company facts

- Company: 温州市嘉伦织带有限公司
- English name: Wenzhou Jialun Webbing Co., Ltd.
- Address: No. 1 Zhongbei Jixiang Road, Tangxia Town, Rui'an, Zhejiang, China
- Materials: polyester and latex
- Width range: 0.8–50cm
- Common widths: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 8 and 10cm
- Common colors: black, brown and white
- Custom colors: available after confirming a physical sample
- Minimum order: confirmed according to specification and quantity
- Main applications: footwear and pet products

## Product range

- Thick elastic webbing / 加厚松紧带
- Premium elastic webbing / 特优松紧带
- Tank elastic webbing / 坦克带
- Sesame elastic webbing / 芝麻带
- Children's shoe elastic / 童鞋带
- Hollow elastic webbing / 中空带
- Gold-thread elastic / 金丝
- Silver-thread elastic / 银丝
- Twill elastic webbing / 斜纹松紧带

## Certifications and test reports

- OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certificate 2608274, issued by CENTEXBEL, valid until 31 August 2027. Product Class I, Annex 6; applies to the polyester elastic bands described in the certificate: https://jialun.net/public/assets/certifications/oeko-tex-standard-100-2608274.pdf
- REACH SVHC test report XNO260709601FX1-1, dated 17 July 2026. Screening of 253 Candidate List SVHCs in submitted footwear elastic webbing samples; conclusion PASS, concentrations below 0.1% by weight. Results apply only to submitted samples: https://jialun.net/public/assets/certifications/reach-svhc-test-report-XNO260709601FX1-1.pdf
